digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration / Bedrock first-class support
propositions: Rebar has no native Bedrock provider path; clients must use an OpenAI-compatible gateway proxy which loses prompt caching and structured output support.
Bedrock prompt caching fails silently on unsupported models (e.g. opus-4-5), billing full input tokens every call with no error or warning.
Bedrock rejects temperature parameter for some models (opus-4-7) with 400 ValidationException, hard-failing rebar gates that use temperature=0 for greedy Pass-2 verification.
The direct-Anthropic path gracefully degrades unsupported sampling parameters via pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings, but the Bedrock path has no equivalent protection.
Rebar must distinguish supported vs unsupported sampling parameters per exact Bedrock model id and warn when caching is requested but both cache counters remain zero.
